title: Left ventricular restoration
scope: Generic class mechanism in representative anatomy. The anatomy, device shape and positions shown are representative of this class; they are not measured on a specific patient or population, and not a specific product. Schematic, not to scale; poses do not predict clinical fit, deformation, performance or flow.
stageLabel: Schematic · representative anatomy · not to scale
attribution: Whole-heart context adapted from Toronto Heart Atlas by Azad Mashari, Joshua Qua Hiansen, Mini Pakkal, Eitan Aziza, Ryan Ramos, Sachin Khargie and Massimiliano Meineri (CC BY 4.0). Display smoothing, vessel continuations and edits for readability are modifications. Detailed tissue shells, defects, device shapes and positions are representative schematics. They are not measured on a specific patient or population, and are not segmented tissue or clinical simulations.

views.label: Whole heart
views.title: Locate the treatment region
views.lesson: Use the highlighted region to orient the enlarged views.

views.label: Ventricles
views.title: Orient the treated ventricular region
views.lesson: Seen from the left, both ventricles are cut open along the length of the left ventricle. One anchor sits on the right ventricular side of the septum and the other on the outside of the left ventricular wall; the connecting element crosses the left ventricular cavity. The chambers come from a real heart model with walls added. The anchor positions and the drawn-in wall are representative and are not measured on a specific patient or population.

views.label: Alternate section

location.label: TREATMENT LOCATION
location.body: The highlighted region locates this class in the heart. The marker is enlarged for orientation.

wall.label: REPRESENTATIVE VENTRICULAR WALL
wall.body: A smooth sectional chamber is representative and is not measured on a specific patient or population.

anchor.label: PAIRED ANCHORS
anchor.body: Two generic fixation elements mark the ends of a connecting element.

link.label: CONNECTING ELEMENT
link.body: A shorter representative span brings the two anchored walls inward. This is a posed comparison, not tissue simulation.

region_LV.label: LEFT VENTRICLE
region_LV.body: The near part of the left ventricle is cut away to show its cavity. In the cinched pose the walls near the anchors are drawn inward; elsewhere the chamber is unchanged.

region_septum.label: VENTRICULAR SEPTUM
region_septum.body: The septum is the shared wall between the two ventricles. One anchor rests on its right ventricular side.

region_RV.label: RIGHT VENTRICLE
region_RV.body: The right ventricle wraps around the septum. Its near wall is cut away to show the septal anchor.

region_anchor.label: PAIRED ANCHORS
region_anchor.body: One generic anchor sits on the outside of the left ventricular wall and the other on the septum, facing the right ventricle. Their positions are representative.

region_link.label: CONNECTING ELEMENT
region_link.body: The element crosses the left ventricular cavity between the anchors. Shortening it draws the two walls toward each other; this is a posed comparison, not tissue simulation.
